title: Bowling Game with Undo/Redo
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with a 3D bowling game using Three.js that features an undo/redo system. Load the '../../../assets/shared/Nefertiti.glb' model using GLTFLoader as a decorative trophy that sits on a pedestal beside the lane.

SCENE SETUP:
- Camera: PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 8, 18) looking down the bowling lane toward the pins.
- Lights: One DirectionalLight at (5, 15, 10) with intensity 1.2, one AmbientLight with intensity 0.4.
- Bowling lane: A long rectangular box (width 3, height 0.2, length 20) colored #C4A36E (wood color), centered at origin, extending along negative Z.
- Gutter: Two dark gray channels on each side of the lane.
- 10 bowling pins: White cylinders (radius 0.15, height 0.6) arranged in standard triangular formation at z = -8. Pins should be named 'pin_0' through 'pin_9'. Store pin standing status.
- Bowling ball: A sphere (radius 0.35) colored dark blue (#1a1a6e) starting at position (0, 0.55, 6).
- Load '../../../assets/shared/Nefertiti.glb' and scale it to 0.015. Place it on a golden pedestal (cylinder, radius 0.5, height 1.5) at position (4, 0, -4) beside the lane. The bust sits on top of the pedestal as a trophy.

PHYSICS (simplified):
- When the player launches the ball, it rolls forward along negative Z at speed 0.3 per frame.
- The ball can be aimed left/right before launch using Arrow keys (adjust ball X position by 0.1 per press, clamped to [-1.2, 1.2]).
- When the ball reaches z < -7, check which pins are within distance 0.7 of the ball's X position. Those pins are 'knocked down' — rotate them 90 degrees on X axis and mark them as fallen.
- After the ball passes z < -10, the throw is complete. Increment the throw count.

UNDO/REDO SYSTEM:
- Each completed throw is recorded as a state snapshot: { ballX, pinsDown: [array of booleans for each pin], score, throwCount }.
- 'U' key triggers UNDO: restores the previous snapshot. Ball returns to start. Pins are restored to their prior state.
- 'R' key triggers REDO: re-applies a snapshot that was undone.
- The undo/redo history stack should be properly managed (redo stack clears on new throw).

HUD/UI:
- Top-left: 'Score: X' showing number of pins knocked down total.
- Top-right: 'Throw: X' showing throw count.
- Bottom-center: 'Press SPACE to launch | Arrows to aim | U=Undo R=Redo' instruction text.
- A div with id 'undo-count' showing how many undo steps are available.
- A div with id 'redo-count' showing how many redo steps are available.

STATE MANAGEMENT — expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- ballX: current ball X position (number)
- ballZ: current ball Z position (number)
- ballLaunched: boolean, true if ball is currently rolling
- throwCount: number of completed throws
- score: total pins knocked down
- pinsDown: array of 10 booleans (true = knocked down)
- undoStackSize: number of available undo states
- redoStackSize: number of available redo states
- nefertitiLoaded: boolean, true once the GLB model is loaded
- gamePhase: 'aiming' | 'rolling' | 'complete' (complete = after ball passes z<-10)

INTERACTIONS:
- ArrowLeft/ArrowRight: move ball left/right during 'aiming' phase.
- Space: launch ball (only during 'aiming' phase). Sets ballLaunched=true, gamePhase='rolling'.
- After throw completes, automatically reset ball to (0, 0.55, 6) and set gamePhase='aiming'. Do NOT reset pins (they stay knocked).
- 'U' key: undo last throw.
- 'R' key: redo undone throw.

Use a CDN for Three.js (r152+) and GLTFLoader. Everything in one HTML file.
physics_constraints: Ball rolls at constant speed along -Z. Pin knockdown is proximity-based (distance < 0.7 from ball center). Ball X clamped to [-1.2, 1.2]. After throw completes, ball resets to start position.
